question: At what specific time should the mantra recitation be performed?
premises: The prescribed day is the fourteenth of the bright fortnight of Caitra.
The recitation is to be done at night.
inference: The practitioner should perform mantra recitation at night on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight of Caitra in spring.
plain_english: One should recite the mantra at night on the fourteenth day of the bright half of Caitra in spring.
